install_fairdiplomacy_package: install the fairdiplomacy package with pip which compiles proto schemas and sets up console scripts
run_protoc_schema_compile: run protoc to compile all proto files in conf/ to Python and MyPy stubs
read_requirements_txt: read and parse requirements.txt stripping comments and blank lines into a list of dependencies
use_postinstall_boilerplate: use the PostInstallBoilerplate custom install command to run proto compilation after pip install
setup_fairdiplomacy_entry_points: configure the fairdiplomacy package setup with diplom and parlai-sweep console script entry points
